_comment: Run state for the SEO/AEO routine. Updated each run. Baselines are a cache; the authoritative time series is the committed seo/data/gsc/ files.
_serp_rotation_note: Index selects clusters (excluding aeo-sentinels) in portfolio order: for k in 0..2, cluster[(index+k) % 9], query[floor(index/9) % len]. Index 0 covered used-car-to-ebike / new-to-boston / family-logistics. Index 3 covers year-round-weather / town-commuters / ebike-curious.

baselines._basis: GSC page dimension, top-25 rows per weekly file (a floor). Query-dimension equivalents kept below for continuity with the 16-week backfill; see seo/reports/2026-08-24.md finding 1.

blockers.what: sentry-triage-email returns 401 to both X-Cron-Secret (CRON_SECRET from .env.local, 64 chars) and the service-role Bearer fallback (SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY from .env.local). The function is reached — the 401 body is its own shape — so the local secrets are out of sync with what is deployed on project xyqcpgwbqrhykpgpqbdi. Every weekly email fails until one is re-synced. The 2026-08-24 email body is saved at seo/reports/2026-08-24-email.txt.
